plugins.name: simplepost
plugins.description: Publish, schedule, draft, preview, inspect, and manage social posts through SimplePost.

skills.name: platform-craft
skills.description: Adapts copy for supported social platforms. Use for write a post, caption, tweet, thread, social copy, or adapt for.
skills.description_zh: 为支持的社交平台调整文案，适用于帖子、图注、推文、线程和跨平台内容适配。

skills.name: post-review
skills.description: Gates every SimplePost publish or schedule write. Use for create post, publish, schedule, post now, or post-review.
skills.description_zh: 为 SimplePost 每次发布或定时写入设置审核关卡，适用于创建帖子、立即发布、安排发布及帖子复核。

skills.name: repurpose
skills.description: Creates platform-specific variants from one idea. Use for repurpose, cross-post, adapt this, or reuse this idea.
skills.description_zh: 从一个创意生成适合不同平台的内容变体，适用于再利用、跨平台发布和内容改编。

skills.name: schedule-tidy
skills.description: Audits the SimplePost queue for cadence and content hygiene. Use for schedule tidy, queue gaps, duplicate angles, stale posts, or reschedule.
skills.description_zh: 审查 SimplePost 发布队列的节奏和内容质量，识别排期缺口、重复角度、过期帖子及需重排内容。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Verifies SimplePost OAuth and connected accounts. Use for setup, first run, sign in, authorization, or no accounts.
skills.description_zh: 验证 SimplePost OAuth 和已连接账号，适用于初始设置、首次运行、登录授权或没有可用账号。

skills.name: simplepost
skills.description: Publish, schedule, draft, preview, inspect, or manage social posts with SimplePost, or integrate SimplePost through MCP, CLI, HTTP, or TypeScript. Use for SimplePost actions and integrations; do not use for generic social copywriting.
skills.description_zh: 通过 SimplePost 发布、排期、起草、预览、检查和管理社交帖子，或通过 MCP、CLI、HTTP、TypeScript 集成。适用于平台操作及集成，不用于通用社交文案写作。

skills.name: week-plan
skills.description: Builds a conflict-aware weekly SimplePost calendar. Use for week plan, content calendar, weekly schedule, or posting cadence.
skills.description_zh: 创建考虑冲突的 SimplePost 每周内容日历，适用于周计划、发布频率和每周排期。
